title: Pydantic Tool Gateway with Scopes and Approval
instructions: Implement the frozen, slotted `Ctx`, `Observation` and `Tool` dataclasses and `ToolRegistry` (`register`, `definitions`, `call`) in `toolgate.py`. `call` checks in a fixed order: unknown tool, scope (before parsing), strict Pydantic argument validation (at most 3 problems reported), approval, then the handler. A failing handler must be logged server-side but never leak its message to the model.

evidence.label: definitions() generates function-calling schemas from the Pydantic models
A valid call runs the handler with the validated model and the session context
An unknown tool returns unknown_tool listing the sorted available names
The scope is checked before arguments are parsed, and approval cannot bypass it
Empty, out-of-range, extra-field, non-object and non-JSON arguments never reach the handler
Validation feedback is capped at three "loc: message" problems
Destructive tools need approval, which does not skip validation
Handler exceptions are logged server-side and never leaked in the observation
Duplicate names and models without extra="forbid" are rejected; dataclasses are frozen and slotted
